setup_description: Awọn eto Android diẹ nilo lati wa ni titan fun MAD Launcher lati ṣiṣẹ ni kikun. Fọwọ ba igbesẹ kan lati fo taara si ọdọ rẹ.
setup_reopen_hint: Tun ṣii nigbakugba pẹlu /ls → Awọn igbanilaaye iṣeto &.
setup_row_home_title: Ṣeto MAD Launcher bi ohun elo Ile rẹ
setup_row_home_why: Eyi ni ohun ti o rọpo iboju ile iṣura rẹ gangan. Laisi rẹ, titẹ Ile kii yoo mu eyikeyi eyi soke.
setup_row_listener_why: Awọn titaniji gidi, awọn aami ti a ko ka, idahun inu window, ati awọn eerun media itẹramọṣẹ gbogbo nilo iraye si iwifunni.
setup_row_overlay_why: Tan eyi ki awọn window iwifunni lilefoofo ati awọn akọsilẹ alalepo le duro lori awọn ohun elo miiran.
setup_row_a11y_title: Tan wiwọle fun nav awọn ọna abuja
setup_row_a11y_why: Agogo yika ati jia joko lori eto 3-bọtini nav bar ni gbogbo app. Akoonu iboju ko ka.
setup_row_contacts_why: Action Box ṣafihan awọn okun app aipẹ ni akọkọ, lẹhinna awọn olubasọrọ foonu rẹ fun @ # *.
setup_row_post_why: Awọn toasts olurannileti agbegbe lati MAD Launcher.
setup_row_battery_title: Alayokuro lati batiri ti o dara ju
setup_row_battery_why: Keeps olutẹtisi ati nav overlays lati a pa ipalọlọ ni abẹlẹ.
setup_row_usage_why: Jẹ ki Awọn aipẹ ati Pupọ lo pẹlu awọn ohun elo ti o ṣii lati awọn ohun elo miiran — atokọ kanna Android tọju fun iboju Akopọ.
setup_row_location_why: Ipo isokuso nikan, nitorinaa ẹrọ ailorukọ oju ojo ile le ṣafihan iwọn otutu gidi kan.
setup_row_read_sms_why: Ipadabọ nigbati foonu rẹ ko ṣe digi SMS si iraye si iwifunni - awọn iṣiro ti a ko ka, awọn ori ila Awọn ifiranṣẹ MAD, ati ohun gbigbọn lati inu apo-iwọle SMS.
help_app_search_desc: Iru: lẹhinna app inagijẹ (fun apẹẹrẹ :yt). Awọn ohun elo nikan pẹlu wiwa inu-app.
help_at_desc: Mu fifiranṣẹ tabi ohun elo imeeli kan, lẹhinna olubasọrọ kan - Apoti iṣẹ yoo ṣii iwiregbe ti o ṣetan lati tẹ. Inagijẹ: txt, ọrọ, msg, ifiranṣẹ, meeli, imeeli, firanšẹ.
help_social_desc: Mu ohun elo awujọ ti o fi sii (pẹlu Facebook) - apoti iṣe ṣi olupilẹṣẹ naa. Ko si ifiweranṣẹ laifọwọyi.
help_contact_lookup_desc: Iru & tabi kan si aaye lẹhinna yan eniyan kan, lẹhinna ohun elo kan si ifiranṣẹ tabi pe.
help_group_desc: Iru? lẹhinna ibeere rẹ; mu oluranlọwọ ti o ba ti fi ọpọlọpọ sori ẹrọ. Aliases: ai, beere ai.
no_ai_assistants: Ko si awọn oluranlọwọ AI ti a rii. Fi ChatGPT sori ẹrọ, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, tabi iru.
placeholder_ask_ai: Beere AI… tẹ ibeere rẹ sii
contact_lookup_banner: Wa olubasọrọ kan, lẹhinna ifiranṣẹ tabi pe
contact_lookup_pick_app: %1$s — gbe ifiranṣẹ tabi ohun elo ipe
help_call_desc: Mu ohun elo pipe kan (Foonu, WhatsApp, Messenger,…), lẹhinna ibaraẹnisọrọ aipẹ kan. Aliases: ipe, ipe, foonu.
help_video_call_desc: Mu ohun elo ipe fidio kan, lẹhinna ibaraẹnisọrọ aipẹ kan. Aliases: vid, fidio.
search_people_to_video_call: Wa awọn eniyan si ipe fidio
help_note_desc: Iru / n lẹhinna Space — mu ohun elo akọsilẹ kan (Keep, bbl) ki o ṣẹda akọsilẹ nibẹ.
help_add_contact_desc: Iru / a tabi ṣafikun olubasọrọ lẹhinna Space — orukọ ati nọmba iyan, lẹhinna mu ohun elo Awọn olubasọrọ rẹ. Ṣii iboju olubasọrọ afikun.
help_translate_desc: Tẹ / t, trans, tabi tumọ lẹhinna Space — aaye naa yọ kuro fun ọrọ rẹ. Yiyan: lati Gẹẹsi si Spanish. Itumọ nṣiṣẹ lori foonu yii, tabi mu ohun elo onitumọ kan.
help_sticky_desc: Fipamọ akọsilẹ alalepo loju iboju ile. Ko ṣii awọn ohun elo miiran.
help_reminder_desc: Ó ṣí Aago. /r tàbí remind, lẹ́yìn náà milk in 20 min fún aago kíkà, tàbí pickup at 8pm fún ìtanijí.
help_schedule_desc: Iṣẹ-ṣiṣe, ọjọ, ati akoko - fi sii kalẹnda.
help_window_desc: Mu window iranlọwọ ni kikun wa.
help_launcher_settings_desc: Awọn ohun elo ti o fẹ, pẹlu Awọn igbanilaaye iṣeto &.
help_action_box_settings_desc: Awọn aṣẹ rẹ, awọn ọrọ ti a ṣe sinu, awọn atokọ app, ati awọn igbanilaaye.
help_settings_search_desc: Ti o dara ju-akitiyan OEM eto.
help_update_desc: Ṣii GetApps tabi Play itaja lori atokọ awọn imudojuiwọn. Fọwọ ba imudojuiwọn gbogbo nibẹ - MAD ko le fi awọn imudojuiwọn sori ẹrọ ni abẹlẹ.
help_nav_desc: Tẹ / g tabi lọ lẹhinna Space — aaye naa n ṣalaye fun aaye kan. nav, lilö kiri, ki o si lọ si tun ṣiṣẹ. Mu Maps tabi Waze ti o ba fi sii.

dock_auto_hide_hint: Ibi iduro ti wa ni ipamọ pẹlu ọpa fifa ti o nfihan. Ra tabi tẹ igi lati ṣii.
dock_auto_hide_bottom_warning: Pẹpẹ fifa le dabaru pẹlu ṣiṣi ohun elo duroa.

dock_show_over_apps_hint: Keeps ibi iduro yii tabi ọpa fifa rẹ loju iboju lakoko ti o lo awọn ohun elo miiran. Nilo igbanilaaye fa-lori.
frequent_usage_access_hint: Tan wiwọle lilo fun a ni kikun ipo kọja Android.
frequent_empty: Lo awọn ohun elo ati MAD yoo pin awọn ti o ṣiṣẹ julọ nibi laifọwọyi.
settings_gestures_hint: Awọn afarajuwe ifilọlẹ ati awọn ọna abuja nav wa ni ibudo eto akọkọ.
settings_home_notif_description: Ohun elo ile, iraye si iwifunni, awọn agbekọja, iraye si, awọn olubasọrọ, ati batiri.
settings_nav_description: Yi nkan jiju nlo 3-bọtini lilọ. Lilọ kiri afarajuwe ko ṣe atilẹyin.
settings_route_preferred_apps: Awọn ohun elo ti o fẹ
settings_unapplied_body: O ni awọn ayipada ti ko tii lo sibẹsibẹ.
settings_hub_themes_subtitle: Awọn awọ, opacity, awọn ipa oju-iwe
settings_hub_icons_subtitle: Apẹrẹ, awọn baaji, ati awọn akopọ aami
settings_hub_nav_subtitle: Classic Android tabi awọn bọtini nav-bar
settings_hub_not_working_subtitle: Awọn ẹya ti o ni opin lori ẹrọ yii
settings_hub_experimental_subtitle: MAD windows, Awọn aipe, ati awọn ọna abuja nav
settings_experimental_intro: Awọn afikun wọnyi rọpo eto Awọn aipe, iboji iwifunni, ati Awọn Eto Yara. Wọn wa ni pipa nipasẹ aiyipada nitori wọn ko ṣiṣẹ ni igbẹkẹle lori ọpọlọpọ awọn foonu.
settings_experimental_mad_windows: Awọn iwifunni MAD ati Awọn eto iyara windows
settings_experimental_mad_windows_off: Paa: Awọn iwifunni ṣii iboji iwifunni. Awọn eto iyara ṣi iboji ti o gbooro sii (kanna bi fifa isalẹ lẹẹmeji).
settings_experimental_mad_windows_on: Lori: Awọn ifiranṣẹ, Awọn ohun elo & System, ati Awọn eto iyara ṣii MAD ti ara awọn window dipo iboji eto.
settings_experimental_help_window_off: Pa: /h ti wa ni satunkọ labẹ Ṣatunkọ ibi iduro/s → ActionBox Eto. Ko si ferese iranlọwọ lilefoofo.
settings_experimental_help_window_on: Lori: / h ṣii atokọ lilefoofo ti awọn pipaṣẹ apoti Action.
settings_experimental_widget_badges_off: Off: the MAD clock widget does not show unread app icons.
settings_experimental_widget_badges_on: On: unread app icons appear on the MAD clock widget.
settings_experimental_mad_recents_off: Paa: Awọn aipẹ (fun-jade ati awọn iṣe aipẹ) ṣi Akopọ foonu naa.
settings_experimental_mad_recents_on: Tan: Awọn aipẹ ṣi window ti awọn ohun elo aipẹ ti MAD. Wiwọle lilo kun atokọ lati awọn ohun elo miiran.
settings_experimental_nav_shortcuts_off: Pa: ko si awọn bọtini agbekọja lori igi nav, ati MAD ko ni idilọwọ awọn titẹ nav. Awọn ipo wa ni fipamọ.
settings_experimental_nav_shortcuts_on: Tan: awọn bọtini agbekọja ati awọn nav taps lo awọn aye rẹ. Ṣatunkọ wọn ni isalẹ.
settings_experimental_need_grants_body: Eyi nilo afikun awọn igbanilaaye. Ṣii ẹbun kọọkan ti o padanu, lẹhinna pada si ibi. Fagilee o kuro.
settings_experimental_grant_overlay: Fa lori awọn ohun elo miiran
compat_upload_body: Orukọ iyan, imeeli, ati awọn akọsilẹ. Jẹrisi fifiranṣẹ .txt ati .json kan si folda awọn ijabọ MAD GitHub.
platform_intro: MAD ṣe deede si OS foonu rẹ. Awọn ẹya to lopin duro ni lilo ṣugbọn o le ma ṣe digi iboji ọja gangan.
platform_partial_sync_body: Diẹ ninu awọn titaniji le ma baramu igi ipo lori ROM yii. Dismiss ni MAD le ma ko iboji eto kuro.
platform_view_not_working: Wo awọn alaye ni Awọn eto ti ko ṣiṣẹ
platform_permissions_warning: Awọn ẹya %1$d ni opin lori ẹrọ yii. Fọwọ ba fun awọn alaye.
setup_row_xiaomi_autostart_why: Aabo app autostart ntọju iwifunni mirroring ati nav awọn ọna abuja laaye lẹhin atunbere.
setup_row_xiaomi_battery_why: HyperOS nigbagbogbo n pa awọn olutẹtisi abẹlẹ. Ṣeto MAD si lilo batiri ti ko ni ihamọ.
setup_row_xiaomi_battery_button: Ṣii awọn eto batiri ohun elo
compat_selftest_waiting: Pari awọn igbanilaaye ti o nilo loke - lẹhinna MAD ṣe idanwo ara ẹni ibaramu nibi.
compat_selftest_subtitle: Helps MAD learn what works on your phone. Re-runs as you grant permissions. Report is optional but appreciated.
compat_github_hint: Tun-ṣayẹwo nikan tun ṣe iwadii naa. Ikojọpọ fi idanwo ara-ẹni ranṣẹ si awọn ijabọ GitHub/compat. Awọn ijabọ kokoro lo Awọn afikun.
settings_palette_hint: Eto atẹle dudu ati eto ina foonu. Nord ati Iṣẹṣọ ogiri ṣi yipada pẹlu rẹ.
settings_landscape_rotate_hint: Layout stays put — nothing scales or slides. Icons and names turn together in place. MAD clock stays stacked (clock, date, weather) and fills its cell; wide third-party strips stay as drawn. Leave off on tablets.
settings_accent_tap_wheel: Tẹ ni kia kia lati ṣii kẹkẹ awọ
settings_infinite_home_pages_hint: Lẹhin oju-iwe ti o kẹhin, ra awọn ipari si akọkọ (ati idakeji).
settings_page_grid_hint: Grid fun awọn oju-iwe ile, Lilo pupọ julọ, ati duroa app. Pa oju-iwe kọọkan kuro ninu akojọ aṣayan isọdi.
